items.name: Default
items.template:
<nve-progressive-filter-chip closable>
  <nve-select>
    <select aria-label="dataset">
      <option>workload</option>
      <option selected>instance</option>
    </select>
  </nve-select>
  <nve-select>
    <select aria-label="condition">
      <option>sort by</option>
      <option selected>filter by</option>
    </select>
  </nve-select>
  <nve-select>
    <select aria-label="filter">
      <option selected>utilization</option>
      <option>status</option>
    </select>
  </nve-select>
</nve-progressive-filter-chip>
items.summary: Basic progressive filter chip with cascading select dropdowns for multi-criteria filtering.

items.name: Multiple
items.template:
<nve-progressive-filter-chip closable>
  <nve-select>
    <select aria-label="dataset">
      <option selected>status</option>
      <option>workload</option>
    </select>
  </nve-select>
  <nve-select>
    <select aria-label="condition">
      <option selected>filter by</option>
      <option>sort by</option>
    </select>
  </nve-select>
  <nve-select>
    <select multiple aria-label="filter">
      <option selected>progress</option>
      <option>pending</option>
      <option>success</option>
      <option>failed</option>
    </select>
  </nve-select>
</nve-progressive-filter-chip>
items.summary: Progressive filter chip with multi-select dropdown for filtering by many values simultaneously.

items.name: TextInput
items.template:
<nve-progressive-filter-chip closable>
  <nve-select>
    <select aria-label="dataset">
      <option selected>memory</option>
      <option>CPU</option>
    </select>
  </nve-select>
  <nve-select>
    <select aria-label="condition">
      <option selected>greater than</option>
      <option>less than</option>
      <option>equal to</option>
    </select>
  </nve-select>
  <nve-input>
    <input type="number" min="0" max="100" value="50" aria-label="filter" />
  </nve-input>
</nve-progressive-filter-chip>
items.summary: Progressive filter chip with numeric text input for threshold-based filtering (greater than, less than).

items.name: DateRange
items.template:
<nve-progressive-filter-chip>
  <nve-select>
    <select aria-label="date type">
      <option>recording date</option>
      <option>process date</option>
    </select>
  </nve-select>
  <nve-date>
    <input type="date" value="2022-05-11" aria-label="start date" />
  </nve-date>
  <nve-date>
    <input type="date" value="2022-12-07" aria-label="end date" />
  </nve-date>
</nve-progressive-filter-chip>
items.summary: Progressive filter chip with date picker inputs for filtering by date range criteria.
